The Shade Room on Instagram: "Whew! An animator who worked on “The Legend of Aang: The Last Airbender” took to X (formerly Twitter) to address the recent leak of the movie, which occurred after Paramount decided not to release it in theaters. In December, it was announced that the film would be exclusively available on the streaming platform Paramount+.
______________________________
Over the weekend, the movie was leaked on X months before its official premiere on Paramount+. The account that shared the leak claimed that Nickelodeon “accidentally” emailed them the full film. Although the tweets were eventually removed, animator #JuliaSchoel expressed her frustration with the leak, stating, “This is incredibly disrespectful to all of the hard work the artists put in.” Schoel also stated that she didn’t like seeing people cite their disappointment over Paramount’s decision about the release as an excuse for leaking it. Thoughts, #Roomies? (SWIPE) ✍🏾:#TSRStaffJR"
